title: coord.py claims, leases and compare-and-swap on a local SQLite store, usable by any agent
goal: python3 _tools/coord.py, standard library only, keeps a SQLite store (one file, path from --store or KB_COORD_STORE) with subcommands that print JSON: claim KEY --ttl SECONDS (create-if-absent, so a second claim of a live key fails with exit 1 and names the holder), renew KEY --token T (extends only the holder's lease), release KEY --token T, get KEY, put KEY --value V --revision N (writes only when the key is still at revision N, else exit 1) and list --prefix P; an expired lease counts as absent, and every write runs in one SQLite transaction so two processes racing on one key cannot both win.
